title: SSL Certificate Expired
description: Restore HTTPS after an expired or misconfigured SSL certificate — renew, reinstall, and fix browser warnings.

steps.title: Confirm Certificate Status
steps.instructions: Check certificate expiry at SSL Labs or browser padlock details. Note if expired, wrong domain, or incomplete chain. Identify who manages certs (host, Cloudflare, Let's Encrypt).

steps.title: Renew or Reissue Certificate
steps.instructions: Renew via hosting panel (AutoSSL, Let's Encrypt) or upload new cert files. For Cloudflare, verify edge cert and origin cert are both valid.

steps.title: Install Full Certificate Chain
steps.instructions: Missing intermediate certificates cause 'not secure' warnings in some browsers. Install cert + intermediate + root bundle as provided by CA or host.

steps.title: Re-enable HTTPS Redirects
steps.instructions: After renewal, confirm http redirects to https. Check .htaccess, nginx config, Cloudflare SSL mode, and Really Simple SSL settings.

steps.title: Fix Mixed Content After SSL Restoration
steps.instructions: Search-replace remaining http:// asset URLs in database. Verify padlock on homepage, checkout, and login pages.

steps.title: Enable Auto-Renewal and Monitoring
steps.instructions: Configure Let's Encrypt auto-renewal or host AutoSSL. Set calendar alert 30 days before expiry. Document cert provider for client.

steps.title: Verify HTTPS Across Site
steps.instructions: Test padlock in Chrome, Firefox, and mobile. Run SSL Labs test for A rating. Confirm no certificate warnings on subdomains if applicable.
